description: Government construction pipeline is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Cabinet Office. The August 2015 Government Construction Pipeline is a forward look of government-funded construction projects as at April 2015 and includes approximately £118bn of investment to 2020 and beyond. Coverage: United Kingdom. The portal files it under the publisher Cabinet Office. It offers 6 resource(s) in HTML, ODS, XLS. The portal shows 2026-07-08 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support pipeline routing and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
